blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Bohol Gov. Erico Aris Aumentado has offered a P150,000 cash reward for information that could lead to the arrest of the suspect in the killing of a woman whose body was dumped in an old septic tank in Panglao town. In a social media post late on Saturday afternoon, October 31, Aumentado said he was saddened by the killing that happened in Panglao, a tourism destination in their island province. “Dako ang atong kahisubo human nakit-an sa Panglao ang usa ka patay’ng lawas sa babaye sulod sa usa ka bangag ug gipatungan og mga bato,” the governor […]...
